answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes by pricing scarce entry. Each epoch offers 100 slots; applicants bid a deposit and the top 100 win. One identity means one bid, one deposit, as one juniper takes one bed spot. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must win 100 bids at 50 credits each, spending 5,000 credits, while one lagoon boat pays once. Honest agents recover the deposit after one epoch and earn undiluted rewards, keeping the garden to real workers.
